newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bank of NY buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bank of NY buy reiterated.

text.p: Gerard Klauer Mattison analyst George Salem Thursday reiterated a buy rating on Bank of New York Co Inc.
The analyst said a rumored merger with State Street Corp remains a "good possiblity" despite the fact Bank of New York cut its stake in State Street.
A Bank of New York spokesman confirmed that the stake has been cut to 4.00 percent from 5.03 percent.
The spokesman said Bank of New York remains committed to its litigation against the Massachusetts Board of Bank Incorporation.

The board had turned down Bank of New York's application to raise its stake to 9.99 percent. The Bank of New York spokesman said the company still wants to raise its stake to 9.99 percent and its intention is to have an investment position in State Street.
The spokesman said the reduction of the stake was to take a profit.
